adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff replaces `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` plus an explicit `console.error("Outlook error grabbing new tokens...", tokenResponse.error, "MS response:", responseJson)` block with `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`. The new helper throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` on parse failure and does not log the provider response, so the specific diagnostics previously emitted are indeed removed. This is a real, diff-grounded observability/debuggability regression, but it does not by itself prove a functional correctness break.
